name: firefly-iii
description: Operate a Firefly III personal-finance instance from Claude Code. Bundles the MCP server registration, a skill teaching the 25-tool surface, four slash commands for common dashboards, and a categorization-audit agent. Covers the full Firefly III agentic surface, not just one workflow. Reads connection details from the FIREFLY_URL, FIREFLY_PAT, FIREFLY_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID, and FIREFLY_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
